description: Manage blog posts and pages, read comments, and watch for new content.

blogger_new_comment_trigger.description: Runs for each new blog comment in Blogger. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, content, published, updated, status, post.id, author.displayName

blogger_new_page_trigger.description: Runs for each new published page in Blogger. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, title, content, url, published, updated, status

blogger_new_post_trigger.description: Runs for each new post published on your Blogger blog. Posts already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, title, content, labels, url, published, updated, status

blogger_updated_page_trigger.description: Runs for each published page added or changed in Blogger. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, title, content, url, published, updated, status

blogger_updated_post_trigger.description: Runs for each published post added or changed in Blogger. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, title, content, labels, url, published, updated, status
